title: Minecraft But I can CRAFT EVERYTHING with DIRT
body:
# Minecraft, But I Can CRAFT EVERYTHING With DIRT

Ever looked at a pile of Dirt and thought *"this should be enough to win the game"*? Now it is. This datapack turns the most useless block in Minecraft into the only resource you'll ever need.

Every recipe below uses **Dirt** as the core ingredient — craft your way from Iron and Gold all the way up to Netherite, Elytra, and even Command Blocks, no mining or Nether trip required.

## ✨ Key Feature: Auto-Unlock

No more digging through the recipe book wondering why your recipes aren't showing up. The moment you pick up a single block of **Dirt**, every custom recipe in this pack instantly unlocks in your recipe book. Just grab some dirt and start crafting.

## 🛠️ Installation

1. Download the `.zip` file — **do not extract it.**
2. Drop it directly into your world's `datapacks` folder, **or**
3. Add it from the **Data Packs** screen when creating a new world.
4. Run `/reload` if added to an existing world.
5. Pick up a Dirt block — recipes unlock automatically!

3. Gold Ingot

*(22 custom recipes in total — check the recipe book in-game or Gallery in Modrinth for exact shapes.)*
